items.title: CrowdStrike CEO: Guardrails alone won't stop uncensored AI cyberattacks
items.summary: CrowdStrike CEO George Kurtz joins Yahoo Finance's Brian Sozzi to discuss how autonomous AI "agent swarms" are accelerating cyberattacks against critical infrastructure and financial systems, requiring real-time AI defenses to counter them. Kurtz also reflects on his investment in the Mercedes Formula 1 team and praises the rapid maturity of young driver Kimi Antonelli.

items.title: AI Agent Swarms Run Up “$1 Million” Bills Before Detection, Palo Alto’s Unit 42 Says
items.summary: Key TakeawaysPalo Alto’s Unit 42 found stolen AI keys running up nearly $1 million in charges before victims caught them. Companies can’t rely solely on AI labs for protection, creating an opening for security vendors.

items.summary: When Microsoft stumbles, some cybersecurity stocks catch a bid. But one leader is still sliding while its rival surges, and an earnings report next week could decide whether this rebound has legs or fades as fast as the outage.
